INSTRUCTION MANUAL & COMPREHENSIVE COMPLIANCE DIRECTIVES UNDER DEVELOPMENT CONTROL REGULATIONS (DCR) 1991 FOR GREATER MUMBAI
SUBJECT: Regulatory Guidelines on FSI Limits in Island City vs Suburbs, Rules Governing DP Road Width Modifications, Coastal Zone Building Height Restrictions (CRZ-II), Mandatory Refuge Floors, Fire Safety Standards, and Unlawful Building Demolition Protocols under MRTP Act 1966.

1. LEGISLATIVE FRAMEWORK OF DCR 1991

1.1 The Development Control Regulations for Greater Mumbai, 1991 (DCR 1991), framed under Section 22 of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning (MRTP) Act, 1966, regulate all land use, building heights, open space requirements, Floor Space Index (FSI) allocations, and structural safety norms within municipal limits.

1.2 Compliance with DCR 1991 is statutory. No officer of MCGM or state government has authority to relax core zoning, FSI, or fire safety rules except through formal statutory amendments published in the Government Gazette.

3. SPECIAL PROVISIONS GOVERNING COASTAL REGULATION ZONE (CRZ-II)

3.1 Interplay between DCR 1991 and CRZ Notification 1991: For plots falling in CRZ-II classification (substantially built-up urban coastal areas), building permissions must strictly conform to the Development Control Regulations existing as on February 19, 1991. Any subsequent amendment in DCR increasing FSI or height limits after February 19, 1991 is inapplicable to CRZ-II plots unless approved by MoEF.

4. ENFORCEMENT & DEMOLITION RULES FOR UNLAWFUL STRUCTURES

4.1 Action under MRTP Act Section 52–54 & MMC Act Section 351: Structures erected in material deviation from sanctioned plans or without valid Occupation Certificate are subject to immediate stop-work notices, revocation of CC, disconnection of municipal water/power, and physical demolition.

5. ROUTINE PARKING & FIRE SAFETY BYLAWS

5.1 Parking Space Norms: DCR 36 mandates 1 parking space per 40 sq. meters of residential built-up area in South Mumbai.

Issued by Order of the Municipal Commissioner:


(J. M. PHATAK / S. S. KSHATRIYA)
Municipal Commissioner, Greater Mumbai
Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (MCGM), Fort, Mumbai
